rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion to an administrable, precedent-tethered rule making state legal/practical responsibility for judgments the central (often controlling) arm-of-the-state indicator in Hyatt’s interstate context, while rejecting waiver under Edelman. The dissent side is likely to fracture into at least one principal dissent (Kagan most likely) emphasizing anti-evasion and insisting on a fuller multifactor inquiry, with possible additional writing from Sotomayor or Jackson stressing fairness and remedial concerns.
